ayahs.1: Yaqeenan guzra hai insaan par ek waqt zamaane mein jab ke yeh koi qaabil-e-zikr cheez na tha.
ayahs.2: Beshak hum ne insaan ko mile-jule nutfe se imtihaan ke liye paida kiya aur us ko sunta dekhta banaya.
ayahs.3: Hum ne use raah dikhaai, ab khwaah woh shukr-guzaar bane khwaah na-shukra.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan hum ne kaafiron ke liye zanjeeren aur tauq aur sholon wali aag taiyyar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.5: Beshak nek log woh jaam piyenge jis ki aamezish kaafoor ki hai.
ayahs.6: Jo ek chashma hai. Jis se Allah ke bande piyenge, is ki nahren nikaal le jaayenge (jidhar chaahen).
ayahs.7: Jo nazr poori karte hain aur us din se darte hain jis ki buraai chaaron taraf phail jaane wali hai.
ayahs.8: Aur Allah Taala ki mohabbat mein khaana khilaate hain miskeen, yateem aur qaidiyon ko.
ayahs.9: Hum to tumhein sirf Allah Taala ki razaamandi ke liye khilaate hain, na tum se badla chaahte hain na shukr-guzaari.
ayahs.10: Beshak hum apne Parwardigaar se us din ka khauf karte hain jo udaasi aur sakhti wala hoga.
ayahs.11: Pas unhein Allah Taala ne us din ki buraai se bacha liya aur unhein taazgi aur khushi pahunchaai.
ayahs.12: Aur unhein un ke sabr ke badle jannat aur reshmi libaas ata farmaaye.
ayahs.13: Yeh wahan takhton par takiye lagaaye hue baithenge. Na wahan aftaab ki garmi dekhenge na jaade ki sakhti.
ayahs.14: Un jannaton ke saaye un par jhuke hue honge aur un ke (mewe aur) guchhe neeche latkaaye hue honge.
ayahs.15: Aur un par chaandi ke bartanon aur un jaamon ka daur karaya jaayega jo sheeshe ke honge.
ayahs.16: Sheeshe bhi chaandi ke, jin ko (saaqi ne) andaaze se naap rakha hoga.
ayahs.17: Aur unhein wahan woh jaam pilaaye jaaenge jin ki aamezish zanjabeel ki hogi.
ayahs.18: Jannat ki ek nahar se jis ka naam Salsabeel hai.
ayahs.19: Aur un ke ird-gird ghoomte phirte honge woh kam-sin bachche jo hamesha rehne wale hain, jab tu unhein dekhe to samjhe ke woh bikhre hue sachche moti hain.
ayahs.20: To wahan jahan kahin bhi nazar daalega saraasar naimaten aur azeem-ush-shaan saltanat hi dekhega.
ayahs.21: Un ke jismon par sabz baareek aur mote reshmi kapde honge aur unhein chaandi ke kangan ka zewar pehnaya jaayega. Aur unhein un ka Rabb paak-saaf sharaab pilaayega.
ayahs.22: (Kaha jaayega) ke yeh hai tumhare aamaal ka badla aur tumhari koshish ki qadr ki gayi.
ayahs.23: Beshak hum ne tujh par ba-tadreej Quran naazil kiya hai.
ayahs.24: Pas tu apne Rabb ke hukm par qaayam reh aur in mein se kisi gunahgaar ya na-shukre ka kaha na maan.
ayahs.25: Aur apne Rabb ke naam ka subah-o-shaam zikr kiya kar.
ayahs.26: Aur raat ke waqt us ke saamne sajde kar aur bahut raat tak us ki tasbeeh kiya kar.
ayahs.27: Beshak yeh log jaldi milne wali (dunya) ko chaahte hain aur apne peechhe ek bade bhaari din ko chhode dete hain.
ayahs.28: Hum ne unhein paida kiya aur hum ne hi un ke jod aur bandhan mazboot kiye, aur hum jab chaahen un ke iwaz un jaise auron ko badal laaen.
ayahs.29: Yaqeenan yeh to ek naseehat hai, pas jo chaahe apne Rabb ki raah le le.
ayahs.30: Aur tum na chaahoge magar yeh ke Allah Taala hi chaahe, beshak Allah Taala ilm wala ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.31: Jise chaahe apni rahmat mein daakhil kar le, aur zaalimon ke liye us ne dardnaak azaab taiyyar kar rakha hai.
